notes.title: Version 14
notes.content:
I have been working on the mobile version and thought it'd be better to update this version.
Hundreds of small bug fixes. Hopefuly, you wont even notice.

notes.title: Version 1.13
notes.content:
* More achievements tested and working
* Leaderboards for high score / highest level and stat UI improvements
* Fix enemy vertical movement - much harder now as planned.
* minor balancing and fixes

notes.title: Berty the Giraffe is now available for early access
notes.content:
Berty the Giraffe is now available for early access

I am working on some bug fixes and new features. This version is in the test branch, so if you feel like checking it out, please do.
